summary: While Trost burns, Mikasa remembers the day her parents died and Eren gave her a home. In the present she hears that he is gone, and then a Titan starts killing other Titans.

segments.ja: トロストの空で、ミカサはアルミンの姿を見つけます。見つけた友は、屋根にへたり込み、エレンの名を言おうとして失敗します。失敗のあと、言葉は短くなります。短くなる内容は、エレンは巨人の口に入った、です。入った事実を、ミカサは一度聞き返します。聞き返す声は、平時の声です。平時の声が、戦場では異常に聞こえます。聞こえる異常の下で、彼女の飛距離が落ちます。落ちる直前、記憶が六年前へ戻ります。
segments.en: In the sky over Trost, Mikasa finds Armin's figure. The friend she found is collapsed on a roof, and he fails when he tries to say Eren's name. After the failure, the words become short. The content that becomes short is that Eren entered a Titan's mouth. Mikasa asks to hear the fact that he entered, once. The voice that asks is a peacetime voice. A peacetime voice sounds abnormal on a battlefield. Under the abnormality that can be heard, her flying distance drops. Just before it drops, memory returns to six years ago.

segments.en: Mikasa's first house was in the woods inside the walls. In the house that was, there were a father, a mother, and quiet meals. On a day of those meals, unknown adults break the door. The purpose of the breaking is to take the girl away as goods. It is. Her parents are killed on the spot. The child hears the sound of the killing in a darkness like under the floor. The world that hears it does not yet know Titans outside the walls. The world she does not know is broken first by human hands.

segments.en: Eren comes alone to the broken house. The reason he comes is that he did not wait for his father Grisha, the doctor, and came to see for himself. He does not handle the abnormal door he saw by running away. The boy who does not handle it that way faces the adults who were inside. The facing is a child's violence, before any training. After the violence, Mikasa is left on the floor. Eren reaches a hand to her, left there. The hand he reaches is not a soldier's hand. It is the hand of someone the same age.

segments.en: Eren wraps his own scarf around Mikasa. The cloth he wraps is both for the cold and for a mark. From then on she almost never takes off the cloth that is there. The reason she does not take it off is that on that day one family died and another family began. The house that began is Grisha and Carla's house. In the house, Carla tidies the girl's hair and adds one place at the table. The gesture of adding is a replacement for the house in the woods. The replacement is not a complete recovery. It is not.

segments.en: For Mikasa, the world is not a beautiful map. It is not. It is a dead house, a living table, and the boy who showed her both. When that boy said he would join the Survey Corps, she chose the place beside him ahead of objection. The reason she chooses is to make the place to return into two people. The extension of doing that is today's Trost. In Trost, that boy is inside a mouth. She hears the report that he is there over the cloth of the scarf.

segments.en: Mikasa, returned from memory, does not fall at once. The blade that does not fall keeps cutting the Titans in the street. The reason she cuts is that if Eren is gone, she will carry the people who remain. The precision of carrying is still first place. Soldiers nearby see the strength left as it is as an abnormal calm. segments.en: Mikasa's cable stops in front of the next roof. The cause of the stop is not technique. It is the end of the gas. When she knows the end, her calm cracks. The reason it cracks is that the center of the people she would carry is already gone. In the world where he is gone, the strength of first place loses its purpose. In the moment of losing it, she puts a knee on the roof. The gesture of putting it looks like a declaration of defeat. A Titan below slowly confirms the declaration that can be seen.

segments.ja: ミカサは、最後の刃を握ったまま、目を閉じかけます。閉じかける思考は、森の家と、カルラの食卓と、赤い布です。布は、まだ首にあります。ある布が、寒い日の代わりに、今日は血の匂いを持っています。持っている匂いの中で、彼女は抵抗を一度やめます。やめることが、強さの終わりに見えます。見える終わりは、まだ完了していません。完了する前に、通りの音が変わります。変わる音は、巨人の悲鳴です。
segments.en: Mikasa, still gripping the last blade, nearly closes her eyes. The thought that nearly closes them is the house in the woods, Carla's table, and the red cloth. The cloth is still at her neck. The cloth that is there, in place of a cold day, has the smell of blood today. Inside the smell it has, she stops resisting once. Stopping looks like the end of strength. The end that can be seen is not yet complete. Before it is complete, the sound of the street changes. The sound that changes is a Titan's cry.

segments.en: Another Titan appears in the street. The opponent that appears is not a person. It is the other Titans. The new body strikes and bites through the napes of the other Titans. Mikasa does not yet understand the reason for the clearing. Without understanding, she opens her eyes. Ahead of the opening is a Titan with its muscle exposed. The Titan that is there makes enemies only of other Titans.

segments.en: When the Titan that brings Titans down advances along the street, the roofs as far as headquarters open for a while. Soldiers who still have gas begin to use the road that opens. segments.en: Mikasa's conclusion is not to say that she likes the world. It is not. It is that the world has a hand that breaks a house and a hand that adds a place at the table. Even after she came back, the hole in Trost stays open. In the town that is open, she looks once more for a way to fly. The things she looks for are gas, headquarters, and a Titan that still has no name.
